prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for animated foreground characters. Create a clean, production-ready transparent PNG atlas, one square image divided into an EXACT, evenly aligned 4-column by 4-row grid of 16 equal square cells. Place exactly one isolated sprite at the CENTER of every cell in row-major order. Leave a broad, completely transparent moat around each sprite: no visible or semi-transparent pixel may come within the outer 18% of any cell edge; keep every full silhouette fully within the central 64% safe area. Each sprite should occupy about 55–60% of its cell at most, leaving generous transparent margins. This safe area and moat are essential for slicing the sheet into separate sprites; no sprite, glow, decoration, or shadow may cross into a neighboring cell. Cell boundaries must be invisible: absolutely no grid lines, borders, boxes, tile backgrounds, paper backdrop, or labels. No extra objects, no text, no letters, no numerals, no watermark. Preserve genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside the sprites. Square 2048×2048 canvas if available; precisely 4×4 equal cells.

Exact 16-cell map, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom:
row 1: cute cyclist riding complete bicycle side profile facing right | friendly emerald frog | retro open laptop with curly-brace symbols only on its screen | fluffy round-eyed kitten with one paw reaching, facing right
row 2: soft puffy cloud | silver-and-coral space-age rocket tilted 45 degrees and pointing upper right with a short flame | teal whale swimming right | curled red fox
row 3: one butterfly | group of exactly three golden fireflies | cyan and coral abstract code braces, no letters | tiny gray mouse facing LEFT
row 4: a second soft puffy cloud | small gold-orange spark cluster suggesting rocket sparks | small cluster of bubbles | thin flowing orange-and-yellow aurora light ribbon.

All assets must be centered within their own cell and clearly separated by the empty transparent moat. Keep subjects simple and readable at small size; maintain one consistent character design and lighting language throughout this sheet.

Style/medium: Japanese woodblock and carved-ink print illustration, bold carved outlines and flat indigo, vermilion, muted gold, and teal pigments. Fine washi grain appears only inside opaque painted shapes; no cream background.
